concept: Growth looks exponential at first, then slows as it nears the limit (carrying capacity).

misconceptions.label: Still in the slow start
misconceptions.why_tempting: The first days barely change, so it feels like growth is slow.
misconceptions.refutation: Early growth compounds: 35% a day multiplies by about 400 in 20 days, until the island's limit slows it.
misconceptions.source_note: Page states the correct model; that this mistake is common is unverified

misconceptions.label: Exponential forever
misconceptions.why_tempting: Exponential growth seems to keep going.
misconceptions.refutation: Growth slows near the limit: the last rabbits come more slowly as space runs out.
misconceptions.source_note: Page states the correct model; that this mistake is common is unverified

items.prompt: An island holds at most 1,000 rabbits. 10 arrive, and early on their number grows about 35% a day. How many rabbits are there after 20 days?

extremes.watch: At 10% a day the island has only about 69 rabbits by day 20.
At 60% a day the island is full (about 999) well before day 20.
